post.caption:
Cameras see detail and colour and are ruined by low sun and rain. Radar sees through weather and cannot identify what it found. Lidar builds exact shapes and struggles in spray and fog. Fusing all three mostly works, and that covers the easy 99% of driving, which is also useless on its own. Everything hard sits in the long tail: hand signals, roadworks, lanes painted over twice, a bag that moves like a rock. There is no list of those, which is why timelines keep slipping.
